img_377.description: Blurred centre of a ring diagram. Around the rim are figures in coloured (blue/red) tubs or barrels. In the inner circle is an uncoloured outline of a long-necked four-legged animal facing right, with a small green tree or plant at the left and green ground beneath.
img_377.central_figure: An outlined quadruped with a long neck and small head, possibly a goat or ram, next to a green plant
img_377.sign_reason: A goat-like or ram-like quadruped beside a tree points to Aries, but the horns are not clear enough to rule out Capricorn or another animal

img_507.description: Blurred central disc, with a figure in a striped tub above it and red and green touches around it. In the centre is a red-outlined quadruped with a heavy body and something like horns, a green patch at its head, and green ground. A grey patch masks part of the lower area.
img_507.central_figure: A heavy reddish four-legged animal with horns, near a green plant
img_507.sign_reason: A heavy-bodied horned quadruped suggests a bull

img_612.description: Blurred centre of a ring diagram, with outlined figures and stars in the surrounding band. In the inner circle is a dark grey-green quadruped with thin legs, a raised head and possibly horns, a solid green shape (tree or bush) at the left, and blue-green ground beneath.
img_612.central_figure: A dark slender quadruped, perhaps a goat or ram, beside a green bush
img_612.sign_reason: A slender horned quadruped with a tree fits a ram or goat; it could also be Capricorn

img_651.description: Blurred centre with a red-painted quadruped standing on green ground. Its head is raised with ears or horns, and there is a green plant at the left. A dark round object sits at the left edge, and a grey patch covers the front legs.
img_651.central_figure: A red four-legged animal with horns or ears and a sturdy body
img_651.sign_reason: A sturdy red horned quadruped reads as a bull; a ram is possible

img_981.description: Very faint, blurred image. Inside the central circle is a pale outline of a quadruped with a few blue strokes and a small red dot. A grey patch covers part of it. The detail is almost washed out.
img_981.central_figure: A faint outlined quadruped, species unclear
img_981.sign_reason: There is an animal outline, but the head, horns and tail are too faint to identify it

img_977.description: Blurred centre with an eight-pointed star above a green-blue four-legged animal. The animal has a long tail curled up into a loop over its back. A grey patch covers its legs, and stars and radial lines fill the ring around it.
img_977.central_figure: A green cat-like quadruped with a long tail curled upward, beneath a star
img_977.sign_reason: A feline body with a long tail raised in a loop is the usual lion pose

img_464.description: Blurred central circle with a human figure wearing a blue cap or hat. The figure holds or stands beside a blue fan-shaped object made of radiating lines, which could be a bow, crossbow or bundle. The outer rings are cut and shuffled or heavily textured.
img_464.central_figure: A person in a blue cap holding a fan-like or bow-like blue object
img_464.sign_reason: A lone human holding a radiating object that might be a bow or crossbow suggests an archer, but the object is unclear

img_525.description: Blurred central circle with a bar or beam held by a central upright, and two round pans hanging from it, one on each side. A grey patch covers the middle.
img_525.sign_reason: A beam with two hanging pans is a balance

img_200.description: Blurred central circle with two standing human figures facing each other and touching hands. The left one has a green hat and green clothes, the right one a blue robe.
img_200.central_figure: Two people standing side by side, holding hands
img_200.sign_reason: A pair of human figures together is the twins

img_486.description: Blurred centre with a single standing figure in a blue garment with a round head or halo. The figure holds a long thin object, perhaps a stick or flower, angled to the lower left. A grey patch covers the lower body.
img_486.central_figure: A single standing woman-like figure in blue holding a stem or stick
img_486.sign_reason: A single robed figure holding a flower or stem fits the maiden

img_738.description: Blurred centre with a red creature with claws or legs and a segmented body. Above it is a pale green elongated shape, possibly a second creature, with red dots to the right. A grey patch lies below.
img_738.central_figure: A red crayfish- or lobster-like creature with claws, and possibly a second green one above
img_738.sign_reason: A clawed crustacean shape, perhaps one of a pair, suggests the crab; a scorpion cannot be excluded

img_374.description: Blurred central circle with two grey-brown fish, one above the other and facing opposite ways, joined by a blue curved line or cord. Stars sit above and below, and a ring of text surrounds them. A grey patch covers part of the upper fish.
img_374.central_figure: Two fish tied together by a cord
img_374.sign_reason: Two fish linked by a line is the classic Pisces image

recognise_source: Yes: the style (nymphs in barrels or tubs around rings of text, centre medallions with an animal, and the cursive script) looks like the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408).
